text: Refti Men Nuli ɓaawo ɓeya Nulaaɓe, Muusaa (yo o his) e Maandeeji Amen tinndinooji goonga makko kan haa e Fir'awna e yimɓe mu'un, tawi alaa ko ɓe waɗa si wanaa yeddugol ɗin Maandeeji. Tasko -an Nulaaɗo, honno battane Fir'awna e yimɓe mu'un wa'unoo ; Alla halkirno ɓe yoolagol, O jokkitiniri ɓe kuddi Aduna e Laakara.
